guides/error-code/hue-bridge-orange-led.title: Hue Bridge: orange LED (kein Internet)
guides/error-code/hue-bridge-orange-led.description: Orange Bridge-LED: lokale Lampen ok, Cloud und Sprachassistenten fallen aus. DHCP, DNS, Kabel.
guides/error-code/hue-bridge-orange-led.h1: Hue Bridge: orange LED ohne Internet
guides/error-code/hue-bridge-orange-led.lead: Die Bridge-LED bleibt orange statt blau; lokale Steuerung geht oft, Cloud-Automationen nicht.

guides/error-code/hue-bridge-50-device-l.title: Hue Bridge: keine neuen Lampen (Zigbee-Limit)
guides/error-code/hue-bridge-50-device-l.description: Pairing scheitert nahe ~50 Leuchten: Geister löschen, nah am Bridge pairen, Kanäle planen.
guides/error-code/hue-bridge-50-device-l.lead: Die App verweigert das Pairing einer blinkenden Lampe, oft ab ~50 Leuchten.

guides/error-code/hue-bridge-orange-led.title: Hue Bridge: oranje LED (geen internet)
guides/error-code/hue-bridge-orange-led.description: Oranje Bridge-LED: lokale lampen ok, cloud en spraakassistenten falen. DHCP, DNS, kabel.
guides/error-code/hue-bridge-orange-led.h1: Hue Bridge: oranje LED zonder internet
guides/error-code/hue-bridge-orange-led.lead: De Bridge-LED blijft oranje in plaats van blauw; lokaal werkt soms, cloud niet.

guides/error-code/hue-bridge-50-device-l.title: Hue Bridge: geen nieuwe lampen (Zigbee-limiet)
guides/error-code/hue-bridge-50-device-l.description: Koppelen mislukt rond ~50 lampen: spookapparaten wissen, dicht bij Bridge koppelen.
guides/error-code/hue-bridge-50-device-l.lead: De app weigert een knipperende lamp te koppelen, vaak na ~50 lampen.

guides/error-code/hue-bridge-orange-led.title: Hue Bridge: LED naranja (sin internet)
guides/error-code/hue-bridge-orange-led.description: LED naranja: bombillas locales ok, nube y asistentes fallan. DHCP, DNS, cable.
guides/error-code/hue-bridge-orange-led.h1: Hue Bridge: LED naranja sin internet
guides/error-code/hue-bridge-orange-led.lead: La LED del Bridge permanece naranja; control local a veces ok, automatizaciones en la nube no.

guides/error-code/hue-bridge-50-device-l.title: Hue Bridge: no se pueden añadir bombillas (límite Zigbee)
guides/error-code/hue-bridge-50-device-l.description: Emparejamiento falla cerca de ~50 luces: borrar fantasmas, emparejar cerca del Bridge.
guides/error-code/hue-bridge-50-device-l.h1: Hue Bridge: límite de dispositivos Zigbee
guides/error-code/hue-bridge-50-device-l.lead: La app rechaza emparejar una bombilla parpadeando, a menudo tras ~50 luces.

guides/error-code/hue-bridge-orange-led.title: Hue Bridge: LED arancione (senza internet)
guides/error-code/hue-bridge-orange-led.description: LED arancione: lampadine locali ok, cloud e assistenti falliscono. DHCP, DNS, cavo.
guides/error-code/hue-bridge-orange-led.h1: Hue Bridge: LED arancione senza internet
guides/error-code/hue-bridge-orange-led.lead: La LED del Bridge resta arancione; controllo locale a volte ok, automazioni cloud no.

guides/error-code/hue-bridge-50-device-l.title: Hue Bridge: impossibile aggiungere lampadine (limite Zigbee)
guides/error-code/hue-bridge-50-device-l.description: Associazione fallisce vicino a ~50 luci: rimuovere fantasmi, associare vicino al Bridge.
guides/error-code/hue-bridge-50-device-l.lead: L’app rifiuta di associare una lampadina lampeggiante, spesso dopo ~50 luci.
